steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stock solutions and buffers as specified.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10X EBSS: 17g NaCl, 1g KCl, 0.35g NaH2PO4•H2O, 2.5g Glucose, 2.5mL Phenol red (0.5%) in ddH2O to 250mL; filter sterilize.
Prepare Papain Buffer (500mL): 60.19mg MgSO4, 2.3g Glucose, 1mL 1M EGTA, 13mL 1M NaHCO3 in ddH2O to 500mL; autoclave.
Prepare 10X Ovomucoid inhibitor (33.3mL): 0.5g BSA, 0.5g Ovomucoid in D-PBS, pH 7.4 with NaOH, filter (0.22µm), aliquot and store at -20°C.
Prepare 6X Ovomucoid inhibitor (33.3mL): 1g BSA, 1g Ovomucoid in D-PBS, pH 7.4 with NaOH, filter (0.22µm), aliquot and store at -20°C.
Prepare DNase I stock: 12,500 U DNase I per 1mL EBSS on ice; filter sterilize, aliquot and store at -80°C.
Prepare BSL 1: 5mg BSL 1 in 1mL 1X HEPES buffered saline (HBS); aliquot and store at 4°C.
Prepare HBS (2X stock, 100mL): 0.8g NaCl, 21mg Na2HPO4, 0.283g HEPES in ddH2O, pH 8.5 with NaOH, then add 1.12mg CaCl2 and 40mg NaN3; filter sterilize.
Prepare Tris-HCl (1L, 50mM): 7.88g Tris-HCl in ddH2O, pH 9.5 with NaOH; autoclave.
Prepare 4% BSA (50mL): 2g BSA in 50mL D-PBS, pH 7.4 with NaOH, filter (0.22µm), aliquot and store at -20°C.
Prepare Trypsin: 50,000 U/mL in EBSS; aliquot (400µL) and store at -80°C.
Prepare Heat-inactivated FBS: Heat shock FBS at 56°C for 1 hour; aliquot and store at -20°C.
Prepare PDL (10mg/mL): 100mg PDL in 10mL 1X borate buffer (1.24g H3BO3, 1.9g NaB4O7 in ddH2O, pH 8.5, 400mL); aliquot and store at -20°C.

Prepare SATO Supplement (20mL): 200mg BSA, 200mg Transferrin, 32mg Putrescine, 5µL Progesterone stock (5mg/200µL ethanol), 200µL Sodium selenite stock (4mg sodium selenite, 10µL 1N NaOH, 10mL DMEM), in DMEM; filter (0.22µm), aliquot and store at -20°C.
Prepare Insulin (0.5mg/mL): 5mg insulin in 10mL sterile water and 50µL 1N HCl; filter (0.22µm), store at 4°C.
Prepare N-acetyl-L-cysteine (5mg/mL): 25mg in 5mL DMEM; aliquot and store at -20°C.
Prepare Forskolin (4.2mg/mL): 50mg in 1mL DMSO, then add 11mL DMSO; aliquot and store at -20°C.
Prepare Biotin (50µg/mL): 100mg biotin in 40mL DMEM (10µM stock), then dilute 20µL stock in 980µL DMEM; aliquot and store at -80°C.
Prepare PDGF-AA (10µg/mL): 50µg in 5mL 0.2% BSA D-PBS; aliquot and store at -80°C.
Prepare bFGF (10µg/mL): 50µg in 5mL 0.2% BSA D-PBS; aliquot and store at -80°C.
Prepare T3 (4µg/mL): 100mg T3 in 5mL DMSO (20mg/mL stock) -> 100µL stock in 4.9mL DMEM (400µg/mL) -> 50µL of that in 4.95mL DMEM; aliquot and store at -80°C.

Prepare Proliferation Media (50mL): Combine 49mL DMEM, 1mL B-27 (-vit A), 500µL Pen-Strep, 500µL GlutaMAX, 500µL Sodium Pyruvate, 500µL Insulin (0.5mg/mL), 500µL SATO, 50µL Trace Elements B, 50µL N-acetyl-L-cysteine, 50µL Forskolin, 10µL Biotin, 50µL PDGF-AA, 50µL bFGF; filter (0.22µm).
Prepare Differentiation Media (50mL): Same as proliferation media but omit PDGF-AA and bFGF; add 500µL of 4µg/mL T3.

steps.title: Prepare Plates (Day Before)
steps.instruction: Coat selection and culture plates overnight.

substeps.instruction: Coat positive selection plate: Dilute 30µL anti-rat IgG (1.3mg/mL) in 10mL Tris-HCl (50mM, pH 9.5). Add to 10cm petri dish, swirl, and incubate at 4°C overnight.

Coat culture plates with PDL: For 10cm dishes, dilute 50µL PDL (10mg/mL) in 10mL sterile water per dish. For coverslips in 6/12-well plates, dilute 120µL PDL in 12mL sterile water per plate (2mL/well for 6-well, 1mL/well for 12-well). Incubate overnight at room temperature.
Prepare 0.2% BSA solution: Dilute 2mL 4% BSA in 38mL D-PBS; store at 4°C.
Prepare 0.5mg/mL insulin solution.

steps.title: Prepare for Immunopanning (Morning Of)
steps.instruction: Finalize plate coatings and prepare digestion buffers.

substeps.instruction: Rinse PDL-coated dishes three times with sterile water and air dry in hood for at least 2 hours.
Coat negative selection plates: Dilute 20µL BSL 1 in 20mL D-PBS. Add 10mL solution to each of two 10cm petri dishes and swirl.

Coat positive selection dish with primary antibody: Rinse the secondary antibody-coated plate (from day before) three times with PBS. Prepare 40µL rat anti-PDGFRα antibody in 10mL 0.2% BSA D-PBS. Coat plate and let sit at room temperature for at least 2 hours.

Prepare digestion/panning solutions: 10X ovomucoid (1mL stock + 9mL D-PBS), 6X ovomucoid (1mL stock + 5mL D-PBS), immunopanning buffer (13.5mL D-PBS, 1.5mL 0.2% BSA D-PBS, 150µL 0.5mg/mL insulin), and 30% FBS (3mL heat-inactivated FBS + 7mL D-PBS).
Equilibrate EBSS: Dilute 800µL 10X EBSS in 7.2mL sterile water; incubate in 10% CO2 incubator at 37°C.

Set up papain digestion system: Set hot plate to maintain buffer at 34°C. Add 10mL papain buffer to a petri dish on the hot plate. Set up humidified 95% O2/5% CO2 gas perfusion (100mL sterile water in 500mL vacuum flask, connected via tubing to gas tank and petri lid).
Activate papain: Add 200U papain, 200µL DNase I (2500U), and 200µL 10mg/mL L-cysteine to the papain buffer. Leave on hot plate with gas flow for 5-10 min.

steps.title: Dissect Mouse Brain
steps.instruction: Extract brain tissue from P6 mice using cold EBSS.

substeps.instruction: Place EBSS in a petri dish on ice.
Cryo-anesthetize and decapitate P6 mice.
Expose skull by cutting skin along midline; cut along sagittal suture from lambda to nasal bone.
Peel back skull, cut underlying nerves, and remove the brain.
Dissect desired regions (include telencephalon and mesencephalon; remove olfactory bulbs, cerebellum, pons, and spinal cord).
Place brain in 15mL conical tube with EBSS.

steps.title: Papain Digestion
steps.instruction: Enzymatically dissociate brain tissue into a single-cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Chop brains into ~1mm3 chunks using a razor blade/scalpel in papain buffer.
Incubate for 90 min under humidified 95% O2/5% CO2 gas perfusion, agitating every 30 min.
Just before 90 min, add 100µL DNase I (1250U) to the 10X ovomucoid solution.
Transfer digested tissue to 15mL tube and add 1mL 10X ovomucoid solution (with DNase I).
Centrifuge for 5 min at 220 xg (room temperature) and aspirate supernatant.
Triturate tissue 7 times with 1.5mL 10X ovomucoid solution using a 5mL pipette (low speed). Transfer supernatant to a new 15mL tube.
Repeat trituration/transfer once more with remaining tissue.
Triturate remaining tissue 7 times with 1mL 10X ovomucoid solution using a 1000µL tip. Transfer supernatant to a new tube.
Repeat until all 10X ovomucoid solution is used.
Centrifuge cells for 15 min at 220 xg (room temperature), aspirate supernatant, and resuspend in 6mL 6X ovomucoid solution by pipetting once.
Centrifuge again for 15 min at 220 xg (room temperature), aspirate supernatant, and resuspend in 6mL immunopanning buffer.
Pre-wet a 40µM cell strainer with 2mL immunopanning buffer. Filter the cell solution and rinse with remaining 7mL immunopanning buffer.

steps.title: Immunopanning
steps.instruction: Isolate PDGFRα+ cells through sequential negative and positive selection.

substeps.instruction: Rinse one BSL 1 coated plate three times with D-PBS. Add filtered cell suspension and incubate at room temperature for 15 min, agitating every 5 min.
Rinse a second BSL 1 plate three times with D-PBS. Transfer non-adherent cells from the first plate to the second and incubate for 15 min (agitate every 5 min).
Rinse the PDGFRα antibody-coated plate three times with D-PBS. Transfer non-adherent cells from the second BSL 1 plate to the PDGFRα plate.
Incubate for 45 min at room temperature, agitating every 15 min.
Rinse the plate three times with D-PBS. Use gravity pipetting onto the same area, swirl once gently, and pipette off.

steps.title: Trypsinization and Plating
steps.instruction: Detach isolated cells and plate for expansion.

substeps.instruction: Add 400µL trypsin to 8mL equilibrated 1X EBSS and apply to the PDGFRα coated plate.
Incubate at 37°C in a cell culture incubator for 6 to 8 min.
Stop reaction with 30% FBS solution. Collect cells in a conical tube.
Centrifuge for 15 min at 220 xg (room temperature).
Resuspend in 1mL proliferation media and count cells.
Plate 500,000 cells per 10cm culture dish and culture in a 10% CO2 incubator.

steps.title: OPC Maintenance and Expansion
steps.instruction: Maintain and expand the OPC culture over several days.

substeps.instruction: At 2 DIV, supplement media with PDGF-AA to a final concentration of 20 ng/mL.
At 4 DIV, perform a half media change.
Perform half media changes every two days.
Passage cells at DIV 7 into cell culture dishes for experiments or into differentiation media (containing T3) if differentiation is required.
